UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private authenticated player account and support contribution summary.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

totalSupportedCents.description: Cumulative USD cents contributed via Stripe support checkout.

lastStripeSessionId.description: Most recent Stripe Checkout session ID or sandbox reference.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when user profile was last updated.

SupportContribution.title: SupportContribution
SupportContribution.description: Verified Stripe support payment receipt saved for an authenticated player.

amountCents.description: Contribution amount in USD cents (100, 500, 1000, or 10000).

stripeSessionId.description: Stripe Checkout session ID or sandbox receipt ID.

stripeProductId.description: Stripe Product ID associated with the checkout.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the support receipt was recorded.

PlaySession.title: PlaySession
PlaySession.description: Tracks a player's play count and high score for a specific game.

gameId.description: Unique identifier of the game in the catalog.

highScore.description: Highest score recorded by this player.

playCount.description: Total number of times the player launched this game.

lastPlayedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last game launch.

FavoriteGame.title: FavoriteGame
FavoriteGame.description: Bookmark entry for a player's favorite game.

gameId.description: Unique identifier of the favorited game.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores private player profile and cumulative Stripe support total.

/users/{userId}/supports/{supportId}.description: Stores verified Stripe support contribution receipts owned by the user.

/users/{userId}/playHistory/{gameId}.description: Stores per-game play counts and high scores owned by the user.

/users/{userId}/favorites/{gameId}.description: Stores games bookmarked by the user.
